description: This is a Java source file implementing the SmsCampaignDomainService interface. It manages SMS campaigns related to various banking/events, handling event listeners, processing data for SMS templates, and sending notifications for loan approvals, rejections, repayments, client activations/rejections, and savings account activities.

classes.name: SmsCampaignDomainServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of SmsCampaignDomainService managing SMS campaigns triggered by various events, including loan approvals, rejections, repayments, client and savings account activities, with event listeners and message processing logic.

methods.name: addListeners
methods.description: Registers event listeners for various business events such as loan approval/rejection, repayment, client activation/rejection, savings account activation/rejection, deposit, withdrawal.

methods.name: notifyRejectedLoanOwner
methods.description: Retrieves and sends SMS notifications for rejected loans.

methods.name: notifyAcceptedLoanOwner
methods.description: Retrieves and sends SMS notifications for approved loans.

methods.name: notifyClientActivated
methods.description: Sends SMS notifications when a client is activated.

methods.name: notifyClientRejected
methods.description: Sends SMS notifications when a client is rejected.

methods.name: notifySavingsAccountActivated
methods.description: Sends SMS notifications when a savings account is activated.

methods.name: notifySavingsAccountRejected
methods.description: Sends SMS notifications when a savings account is rejected.

methods.name: sendSmsForLoanRepayment
methods.description: Processes and sends SMS notifications related to loan repayments, including assembling data and handling group loans.

methods.name: sendSmsForSavingsTransaction
methods.description: Processes and sends SMS for savings account deposit or withdrawal transactions.

methods.name: retrieveSmsCampaigns
methods.description: Fetches active SMS campaigns matching a specific trigger type.

methods.name: processRepaymentDataForSms
methods.description: Prepares data parameters for SMS template for a loan repayment event.

methods.name: processSavingsTransactionDataForSms
methods.description: Prepares data parameters for SMS template for savings deposit or withdrawal events.
